Subject: Ridgeline 2P is back — a small shipment just landed
Preview: Limited units of the Ridgeline 2P are in. Here's what you need to know before they move.
Body: Hey,

A limited restock of the Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02) has arrived. We're letting you know now because this batch is small and we don't have a timeline on the next one.

A quick recap of what the tent actually is:

- 2-person, 3-season shelter — built for spring through fall conditions; not designed for winter or sustained heavy snow load
- 2.1 kg packed weight, so it's manageable on a multi-night trip without dominating your pack
- Ripstop nylon construction on both the fly and canopy

If you've been waiting on this one, now is a reasonable time to move on it. Units are available while stock lasts — we'll pull the listing as soon as it sells out.

Check current availability below.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
